summary: 38 units, Sāmaveda 4.6 (955-992). Tokens all match the printed text; no invented Sanskrit. 6 errors, 27 minor issues in 22 units; the rest ok. Errors: 972 Hindi supplies a verb the English lacks; 974 makha rendered 'vigorous one' against the glossary (Makha); 983 Hindi 'spread' vs English 'stand apart'; 984 English drops one of two tvām; 987 trāyethām labelled present but is the imperative; 989 garbled Hindi. Minor: saḥ rendered 'you'/तुम in 956, 970, 978, 980; RV parallels removed from notes/flag reasons in 959, 961, 979, 983, 984; assorted Hindi additions/ungrammatical forms (955, 967, 970, 983, 984, 985, 992); gram/gloss labels (959, 973, 987, 990). Text flags kept: 959, 960, 979, 983 (ṣ after k only; the ँ is regular), 984 (tavāṃ only; agni~ is regular). All other ~ forms are regular and unflagged. Manual: 960 vidharmaṇi ([unclear] here, 'in the support, foundation' in p01/ch11 521/529, 'in the upholding' in chunk2 1017); 986 syntax of 'tā vām' and the added 'from'. No regrouping suggested.
